query.title: Search
query.description: Search available downloadable sound names. Empty query browses the library.

ids.title: Exact sound IDs
ids.description: Optional IDs returned by a previous search. Unknown IDs are rejected.

maxDuration.title: Maximum duration (seconds)
maxDuration.description: Only return effects no longer than this duration.

limit.title: Maximum sounds
limit.description: Maximum WAV files to deliver. Each successfully stored file emits one sound-delivered event. No matches means no delivery charge.
